department: Chemistry and Biochemistry, School of Mathematics and Natural Sciences

deadline.value: The earliest international Fall date is May 1, 2027; chemistry also asks for June 1 for visa processing.

also.quote: the application should be submitted by June 1 and November 1 for Fall and Spring admission

gre_general.value: The chemistry department no longer requires the GRE General test; applicants may still submit it.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) general test is no longer required

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry lists a TOEFL iBT minimum of 71.

ielts_min.value: Chemistry lists an IELTS Academic overall minimum of 6.0.

english_waiver.value: The chemistry test waiver covers degrees from listed countries only, which excludes India, so Indian applicants need a test.
english_waiver.quote: may be waived if the applicant has completed a post-secondary degree at an accredited university in the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Ireland, Nigeria, Ghana, or certain Caribbean islands

supervisor.value: Applicants need not secure a research advisor before applying; admitted students join a group after rotations.
supervisor.quote: contacting or securing a research advisor is not required before applying

funding.value: Assistantships are limited and granted competitively; teaching assistantships often carry a full tuition waiver.
funding.quote: Assistantships are limited and are granted on a competitive basis

also.quote: Teaching assistantships often come with a full tuition waiver

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's need a 2.75 GPA on their last 60 undergraduate hours; those with a master's need 3.5 on graduate work.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to a doctoral program who have not earned a master's degree must have at least a 2.75 GPA on their last 60 hours of undergraduate work

also.quote: Applicants to a doctoral program who have earned a master's degree must have at least a 3.5 GPA on all previous graduate work

name: Chemistry PhD
